s0.ru: Видов {kinds}, номера с 1. Лента из {n} значений: {listing}. На какой позиции впервые встречены все виды? Если набор так и не собран, ответ 0.
s0.en: There are {kinds} kinds, numbered from 1. A tape of {n} values: {listing}. At which position have all kinds been seen for the first time? If the set is never complete, the answer is 0.

s1.en: There are {kinds} kinds, numbered from 1. A tape of {n} values: {listing}. How many values arrive after the position where all kinds are first complete? If the set is never complete, the answer is 0.
